title: Beware! Vertical stripes, not horizontal
text:
Beware! Vertical stripes, not horizontal. Expected stripes to run from left to right. When I started to measure the film before cutting I was unpleasantly surprised to find that the stripes on the roll went from top to bottom, which was NOT what I'd expected. Had to cut-n-paste, not as easy as it'd looked.
Might work for a sliding glass door.
